failure: Root actual Windows25 SRV lookup failed before authentication despite independent OS DNS success on a private DNS-only NIC. Forced Go DNS selection excludes no-gateway adapters in installed Go1.27.4.
correction: Use a fresh standard-library resolver with normal OS selection, retaining strict errors and absolute explicit queries. No locator, inferred domain, endpoint retry or host route change.
cancellation_red_green: Three noninterruptible OS-style resolver stages previously waited after cancellation and could append late addresses. Bounded buffered per-query ownership now returns promptly, preserves completed partial replies and discards late results.
native_query_lifetime: An OS DNS query can continue until the OS returns; it owns only its buffered result and never mutates returned SDK output.
